C01.why: Enters the single hottest, fastest-cloning lane on Roblox (job-by-day/anomaly-by-night); co-op CCTV/patrol roles are the only real twist and the licensed Exit 8 already ships 8-player co-op. Players already have Sell Fries!, 7 Days Cat-Sitting and dozens of anomaly obbies, so 'motel + friends' is a reskin pitch.
C01.fix: Make the role split the hook rather than the setting: e.g. the CCTV player sees anomalies others cannot and must guide patrollers with pings only (information asymmetry), so the game cannot be played as a solo anomaly-spotter.
C01.competitors: Sell Fries! (~112K peak), 7 Days Cat-Sitting, licensed The Exit 8 (8-player co-op), Scary Shawarma Kiosk-style games, many anomaly obbies

C02.why: Searches found no Roblox Keep-Talking-style asymmetric defusal game; the emote/laser-only communication is a genuine Roblox-native twist (works without chat) and rides BOMBANANA's Steam momentum. USP is one sentence and instantly legible; moat is moderate since the procedural module library and rule-page generator take real design work to clone well.
C02.fix: Ship 25+ module types and a weekly community-voted module at launch so a cloner copying the 3-role frame still lags far behind on content depth; trademark the Hands/Eyes/Book role identity in thumbnails.
C02.competitors: None found on Roblox (searched); off-platform: Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes, BOMBANANA!

C03.why: Not empty: Boat Together [1-6 Player] (~8.2M visits) already sells 'row in sync' co-op, and Fart Together's copy proved the shared-vehicle hook but also that clones appear instantly. Swappable thruster layouts (bathtub, cart, balloon) and team races are a real but thin differentiator.
C03.fix: Make vehicle layouts the identity: a new absurd vehicle with a distinct coordination puzzle every 2 weeks plus asymmetric seats (one seat brakes, one seat jumps), so it reads as a vehicle collection game rather than 'Boat Together 2'.
C03.competitors: Boat Together [1-6 Player] (Roblox, ~8.2M visits), Backseat Rally (28-55K peak), removed Fart Together copy; off-platform Are We Sinking Yet?, Huddle Raft

C04.why: No Roblox antique appraisal/counterfeit-detection game found; closest is the tiny art-forgery 'Fake a Masterpiece' (~1 CCU peak). Inspection-tools + forger PvP is a clear, theme-fresh USP aligned with Probably Stolen's Steam momentum, but the shop-tycoon wrapper is generic and the core tool-drag UI is simple to clone.
C04.fix: Lean on the Forger Night social-deduction mode as the headline (not a side mode) and build a large, handcrafted tell catalogue (200+ items with lore) that clones cannot replicate quickly.
C04.competitors: Fake a Masterpiece (Roblox, negligible CCU); generic shop tycoons; off-platform Probably Stolen, Papers, Please

C05.why: The 'clean before mom gets home' theme is already occupied by Clean the House! (Snowy Interactive, ~5-6K peak, CH2), but that is a PvE chore game; the party -> panic-hide -> parent-inspects 1vN structure with snitching is distinct and highly shareable. Title/theme collision risk with an existing mid-size game lowers clarity.
C05.fix: Differentiate branding away from 'clean the house' (lead with the PARTY and the 1vN inspection, e.g. 'Grounded!') and make physics evidence-hiding (rugs, dog-over-stain) the trailer moment.
C05.competitors: [Clean the House!] by Snowy Interactive (~870K-1.3M visits, ~6K peak), Granny-type chase games, break-the-house physics games; off-platform No Body No Problem!, Worst Class Ever

C06.why: Shared server haystack is a cute twist, but it sits inside the most saturated and now-declining format (incremental/tycoon); the core 'tap, buy machine, auto-collect' loop is exactly what kit-built clones replicate in days. Browser needle clickers already exist.
C06.fix: Make the server-wide shared pile the whole game: competitive plots that can steal hay from each other's conveyors or sabotage, with a timed weekly needle race and global leaderboard, so it isn't just another tycoon.
C06.competitors: Countless Roblox tycoons/incrementals; browser needle-in-haystack clickers (Poki/CrazyGames); off-platform Find the Needle

C07.why: Deeply saturated: Chained [2 Player Obby] alone has ~430M visits and ~45K peak, and the 2024 chained-together wave left dozens of copies; PEAK-likes (SUMMIT) exist too. Stamina/anchor adds little a player would notice from a thumbnail.
C07.fix: Abandon the 'chained' framing and differentiate on the PEAK-style expedition layer (daily seeded procedural mountain, survival/cold, item sharing, summit photo) with a distinct name, so it competes with the near-empty SUMMIT slot rather than chained obbies.
C07.competitors: Chained [2 Player Obby] (~431M visits, ~45K peak), Chained (2 Player Obby) (~27M visits), many chained obbies, SUMMIT (~1K peak)

C08.why: Content Warning-inspired Roblox games exist (listings with camera/found-footage mechanics, Short Creepy Stories), but none appear dominant; ghost-hunting is crowded. The lobby-theatre montage scoring is the differentiator, but it is a meta-layer, not visible in moment-to-moment play.
C08.fix: Make the 'views' a live social feature: the montage is voted on by other lobbies (emoji reactions) and top clips appear on a server-wide billboard, giving a reason to choose this over generic ghost hunts.
C08.competitors: Several Content Warning-style Roblox experiences (unranked, small), Short Creepy Stories, assorted Phasmophobia-like ghost hunts

C09.why: Not untouched: [Draw Spells Magic Arena] exists (PvP, ~615 CCU snapshot, 0.4-1.5M visits), proving the mechanic but leaving it weak. Co-op wave defense plus cross-player spell combos is a meaningful twist and gesture input is mobile-native, but rune recognition is easy to copy once seen.
C09.fix: Make cross-player combos the signature (two players drawing simultaneously to fuse spells, with visible combo names) and build a big discoverable rune book, so the identity is 'co-op spell combos' rather than 'draw a spell'.
C09.competitors: Draw Spells Magic Arena (Roblox, small), other draw-duel listings; off-platform Magicka, YAPYAP

C10.why: Breeding-with-inheritance on top of auto-battle roguelite runs is genuinely novel on Roblox, but it competes for the same audience as massive pet sims and anime/unit battlers (Units Battlegrounds), and the USP is two-step (battle, then breed), which is harder to convey in a thumbnail.
C10.fix: Put mutation visibility front and centre: wild, shareable visual mutations and a public family-tree showcase/trading of bloodlines, so the pitch is 'breed the weirdest critter' in one image.
C10.competitors: Pet simulators and gacha tower-defense games (crowded), Units Battlegrounds (early auto-battler); off-platform Mewgenics

C11.why: Liminal co-op extraction is crowded and recently claimed: DONT SPLASH (~116K peak) plus many liminal obbies and R.E.P.O. clones. Nothing in the pitch is distinct enough to beat incumbents or survive the next clone wave.
C11.fix: Find one mechanical twist the incumbents lack (e.g. the entity is controlled by an opposing player who earns what you drop, making it 1vN) and lead with it.
C11.competitors: DONT SPLASH (~116K peak, ~9.7M visits/day), many liminal/backrooms obbies, R.E.P.O.-style Roblox clones

C12.why: The airplane-emergency co-op niche already exists: Land or Die! (crippled airliner, crew fixes systems), Survive the Plane Crash and Skyline Airlines roleplay; Backseat Rally owns the role-split brand. Strict information-asymmetric roles (pilot blind to gauges) are a differentiator, but the theme is not fresh.
C12.fix: Lean into the vehicle roster (airship, submarine, rocket) and strict info-split so it reads as 'Keep Talking in a cockpit', and avoid 'plane crash' framing that collides with Land or Die!.
C12.competitors: Land or Die! (Roblox, co-op crippled airliner), Survive the Plane Crash, Skyline Airlines, Backseat Rally (28-55K peak)

C13.why: Not a near-empty genre: Borders RTS is a direct Luau port of OpenFrontIO, and RoFront and PixelFront offer world-map land-grab RTS. Since OpenFront is open-source and already ported, cloning cost is near zero and the pitch has no USP beyond the source game.
C13.fix: Add a Roblox-native hook absent from ports, e.g. clans own persistent territory on a weekly season map, or 3D avatar 'generals' who duel at front lines, so it isn't another OpenFront port.
C13.competitors: Borders RTS (OpenFrontIO port), RoFront, PixelFront, Territory Tiles (WIP)

C14.why: Fragile carry exists in small form (Carry the Glass Together, Don't Shatter [2 Player Obby]), value meters are a R.E.P.O.-clone staple, and delivery sims exist. The full order -> drive -> co-carry -> tip loop is a modest step beyond these.
C14.fix: Make the cargo the star: absurd, physically distinct items (live aquarium sloshing, tiered wedding cake that sags) with unique handling rules, plus versus sabotage between courier teams, so it isn't 'R.E.P.O. with a van'.
C14.competitors: Carry the Glass Together, Don't Shatter [2 Player Obby], R.E.P.O.-style Roblox clones, delivery sims; off-platform Totally Reliable Delivery Service

C15.why: Auto-battlers are thin on Roblox (Units Battlegrounds, Merge a Mini Army), and the shared-conveyor draft plus Fall Guys-style elimination is a reasonable twist on Merge Tactics. But 'toys' is a weak USP, and a 2D board game is among the fastest things to clone with AI tools.
C15.fix: Differentiate with the shared conveyor as a social mechanic (snipe/deny pieces others need, visible to all) and a distinctive toy IP with collectible personalities, then defend with ranked seasons and balance live-ops.
C15.competitors: Units Battlegrounds, Merge a Mini Army (Roblox); off-platform Clash Royale Merge Tactics, TFT

C16.why: Directly overlaps 7 Days Cat-Sitting (rising, Sep 2026) and existing animal-care games, without even the anomaly-horror twist that makes Cat-Sitting stand out. No reason to choose it over the incumbent.
C16.fix: Add a sharp twist incumbents lack, e.g. 1vN where one player secretly controls the chaotic pet while others pet-sit, turning it into an asymmetric party game.
C16.competitors: 7 Days Cat-Sitting, Animal Hospital, generic pet-care/roleplay games

C17.why: No Roblox Tricky Towers equivalent surfaced, so the slot is open, but stacking is a low-hook, easily cloned concept and nothing in the pitch is distinctive beyond weather events.
C17.fix: Add a signature twist, such as players physically standing on and climbing the tower they build (avatars as weight), or a versus sabotage card system, to make it uniquely Roblox.
C17.competitors: None found on Roblox (searched); off-platform Tricky Towers, Jenga

C18.why: No competitor found for a whole server raising one monster that battles other servers weekly; the cross-server rivalry is a novel, hard-to-clone social structure (needs persistence, live ops and community). The pitch is underspecified and similar to 'Twitch Plays' gimmicks that can fizzle.
C18.fix: Specify the weekly battle as a watchable live event with visible server-vs-server standings and named, persistent monsters players are attached to, so the USP is concrete rather than a concept.
C18.competitors: None found (not specifically searched beyond panel research); conceptually adjacent to pet sims and Tamagotchi/Twitch Plays

C19.why: NPC-blend is an established and well-cloned Roblox format (Be NPC or Die, DISGUISE, In Plain Sight, Prank the Teacher). The statue/flashlight-freeze and shared mischief meter are a solid twist, but players will perceive it as another hide-in-plain-sight game.
C19.fix: Make the flashlight-freeze mechanic the defining rule (any statue in the beam must hold a pose matching a placard, tested via pose button), and add a physics-prank element so trailers show something no blend game has.
C19.competitors: Be NPC or Die, DISGUISE, In Plain Sight, Prank the Teacher games; Roblox clones of Meccha Chameleon

C20.why: Volleyball Legends is an entrenched incumbent (~35-57K CCU in 2026 snapshots, ~74K peak) with a Haikyuu-style identity and an active update cadence; one-touch tap volleyball offers no reason to switch and is trivially clonable.
C20.fix: Pick a different sport or a radically different format (e.g. 2v2 physics-ragdoll beach volley on mobile with party modifiers) that Volleyball Legends players would see as a different game.

overall_notes: About 15 targeted web searches; tracker figures are snapshots and disagree across sources. Biggest corrections to the pitches: C07 faces Chained [2 Player Obby] (~431M visits); C13's 'near-empty genre' is wrong (Borders RTS is a direct OpenFront port, plus RoFront and PixelFront); C09 has a small direct predecessor (Draw Spells Magic Arena); C03 has Boat Together [1-6 Player]; C12 has Land or Die! (co-op crippled airliner); C05's theme overlaps Clean the House! (Snowy Interactive). Searches found nothing for C02 (Keep Talking-style), C04 (antique appraisal; only the tiny Fake a Masterpiece) or C17 (Tricky Towers). The strongest differentiation comes from concepts whose USP sits in a structural rule (info asymmetry, 1vN inspection, cross-server rivalry) rather than a theme, because themes get reskinned by AI-built clones within days, while rule systems with deep content libraries hold up longer.
